queries_run: Cummins PACCAR engine supplier 2026 in-house OR second source OR own engine

findings.claim: PACCAR為最大客戶，占2025合併銷售13%（2024、2023為16%）；長約不保證特定數量；失去該客戶或PACCAR產量大降會有不利影響。
findings.excerpt: PACCAR is our largest customer, accounting for 13 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2025, 16 percent in 2024 and 16 percent in 2023.

findings.claim: 10-K風險因素載明部分現有客戶可能自行開發或改向其他製造商採購（電動化動力系統情境）。
findings.excerpt: Some of our existing customers could choose to develop their own or source from other manufacturers.

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未找到2026年PACCAR–Cummins合約變更或第二供應商協議的公告；PACCAR重卡引擎本就自製（MX），搜尋摘要來自低權威來源，未列入findings。
